Boeing 2024.lesson: A safety crisis at a famous manufacturer can erase years of margin and trust at once.

beats.headline: Door panel detaches in flight; model grounded
facts: The maker will review quality control.

beats.headline: Chief executive to step down
facts: Cash burn guided to $4 billion for the year.

beats.headline: Second-quarter loss
facts: A workforce reduction of 10% is planned.

Marrow Bay Brewing.lesson: A small brewer that grows faster than its cash flow can finance ends up selling equity at a low price.

beats.headline: Second plant opens
facts: The plant cost $4.2 million, funded by short-term bank debt.

beats.headline: Sales up, cash flow negative
facts: Sales rise 35% but operating cash flow stays negative.

beats.headline: Discounted share sale
facts: New shares are sold at a 20% discount to repay the credit line.

Tidewell Ferries.lesson: A ferry operator with one reported event cannot teach a sequence.
